name: Wixárika Route through Sacred Sites to Wirikuta (Tatehuarí Huajuyé)
description: This is a network of 20 sacred sites linked by pilgrimage trails that stretch over 500 km across five Mexican states. The Wixárika (Huichol) people follow them from their mountain homeland in the Sierra to Wirikuta, a high desert in San Luis Potosí. Walkers cross forests, mountains and arid plains, making offerings to ancestral deities. Because the Wixárika have no written language, the journey also keeps their traditions alive.
